acknowledgements.title: Acknowledgements
banner.hashtag.disclaimer: This is a public hashtag timeline. Content is moderated by you, the Hashiverse community. If you encounter material you find offensive or distressing, please use the report buttons to add your voice to the community.  Images are blurred by default — tap to view them.
banner.hashtags_detail: Here are the combined posts from all the hashtags you follow. You can follow or unfollow an individual hashtag by clicking it and then pressing Follow/Unfollow on its timeline.  Alternatively, you can manage them as a group in <settings>Settings</settings>.
banner.hashtags_not_logged_in: You need to log in to view posts from the hashtags you follow.
banner.me_detail: Here are your recent posts. You can share your profile with others by tapping on the QR code.
banner.people_detail: Here are the combined posts of all the people you follow. You can add and remove an individual by clicking on them and then pressing Follow/Unfollow on their timeline.  Alternatively, you can manage them as a group in <settings>Settings</settings>.
banner.people_not_logged_in: You need to log in to view the posts from the people you follow.
banner.replies_detail: Below are the replies to your selected post. Only the most recent are automatically loaded, so you might need to manually load further back in time.
banner.sequels_detail: Below are the sequels to your selected post. Only sequels from the past year are automatically discovered, so you might need to manually load further back in time.
banner_not_logged_in.message: You are not yet logged in to the Hashiverse, so you can just browse for now.

feedback.csam_confirm_warning:
You are about to report this content as Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM). Falsely reporting CSAM is illegal in many jurisdictions because it overwhelms law enforcement and divert resources away from investigators working on genuine cases of child abuse.

Only submit this report if you genuinely believe this content depicts the sexual abuse of a minor.

home.banner_detail: Remember when social media was still cool? No spam? No ads? No algorithms perverting your reality? Hashiverse is owned by you, the Hashiverse community. It is completely open-source, and its servers are sponsored by thousands of active volunteers.  Join us in taking back our Internet!

login.banner_detail: Please choose how you want to log in to Hashiverse. Hashiverse is a decentralised system, owned by nobody but you, the Hashiverse community. This means that only you can recover your own login information.
login.instruction_keyphrase: If you are using a password manager, use it to generate a large random keyphrase.  You will need this exact keyphrase if you want to log in on a different machien or Hashiverse domain.  Anyone else with this keyphrase will control your account, so make sure it is long!
login.instruction_passkey: Use your fingerprint, face or pin to sign in. If your passkey syncs via iCloud, Windows Hello, or Google Password Manager, this same login works on any of your devices.  NB: Your account will only ever be available on the Hashiverse domain at {{domain}}.
login.instruction_questions: Please answer these questions carefully - they uniquely determine your identity in the Hashiverse. If ever you want to log in on a different machine or Hashiverse domain, you will need to provide exactly the same answers again.
login.keyphrase_placeholder: Paste or type your keyphrase here...
login.passkey_no_passkey_hint: No passkey found for Hashiverse on this device? You can create one — but note this generates a brand-new Hashiverse identity, not a recovery of an existing one.
login.passkey_title: Log in with your fingerprint, face or pin
login.passkey_unsupported: Passkey login is not available in this browser. Try Chrome 116+, Edge 116+, or Safari 17.4+.
